# sreagent_sli (Resource)

A service level indicator. Approving one stays a human decision in the app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sreagent_sli" "latency" {
  name     = "checkout latency"
  sli_type = "latency"
  service  = "checkout"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Shown on the SLO pages.
- `sli_type` (String) latency, availability and so on. Changing it replaces the SLI.

### Optional

- `data_source_id` (String) The data source the query runs on.
- `description` (String) What the indicator measures.
- `query` (String) The query against the data source.
- `service` (String) The service measured.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `status` (String) draft, approved or archived; changed in the app.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax, or with an `import` block
naming the same ID. See the [importing guide](../guides/importing.md).

```shell
# Collections import by id.
terraform import sreagent_sli.latency 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
